📖 Tips

• Wood → Planks → Crafting Table → Pickaxe! At night Gloomlings appear.
• Caves and nights are dark — craft a Lantern (Coal + Stick + Planks) and sleep through the night in a Bed.
• At night Zombies and bow-wielding Skeleton Archers roam, and Ember Blobs hide in deep caves. Prepare with armor, a bow and a Shield (6 Planks + 1 Iron Ingot).
• Use a Dimension Compass (3 Iron Ingots + 1 Energy Stone) to find the Frontier's portals and challenge the bosses of the Abyss (Pandemonium lies deep below), the Horizon and the Necropolis.
  The Horizon portal is in an underground Marker Stone room and opens with 12 Portal Keys dropped by Teleporters. The Necropolis portal is in an infected ruined village deep underground.
• Water and lava flow. Still water meeting still lava makes Obsidian; if either is flowing you get Cobblestone. Obsidian needs an Iron Pickaxe or better.
• A village Blacksmith's House has enough lava on its floor (10 blocks) for one portal. Build a 4×5 frame from 10~14 Obsidian to open an Abyss Portal.
• Stack Iron Blocks in a T shape and put Wooden Planks on top to awaken a Villager Guardian.
• Trade with villagers in Villages using Coins. Hurt a villager and the Guardian will chase you until you leave!
• Doors (6 Planks → 3) are 2 blocks tall and open with right click✋. Chop a whole tree and a Sapling drops — plant it on grass or dirt and it grows in a few minutes.
• Climb Ladders (7 Sticks) placed on walls, store things in Chests (8 Planks), and Hoppers (5 Iron Ingots + Chest) suck up items from above into the chest below.
• Mace = Iron Rod (8 Iron Ingots + 1 Stick) + Mace Head (1 Iron Ingot + 8 Spikes). One hit every 2.5s for 20! It hits harder the higher you fall from, and sprinting headshots deal 1.5×.
• Wear Elytra (10 Feathers + 4 Sticky Silk + 2 Crystals, also dropped by the Ender Dragon) in the chest slot and press Jump again while falling to glide. Look down to speed up, up to climb. Use a Firework (1 Coal + 1 Stick → 3) while flying to boost forward!
• 🛰 Stellar Remote (8 Energy Stones around 1 Star Power) — The Shooting Star! Reshape the world with CB-TSR Railgun (50-block radius) · CB-NM Gungnir (400 blocks) · CB-SL Seven Stars (1,440 blocks), each with a space cutscene through Earth, Saturn, the galaxy, Mars, Jupiter and Ursa Major (K/I/U select · right click✋ fire · crouch-use for next skill · H menu · J skip / hold the remote and press J to toggle cutscenes). It changes the world forever — use it carefully!
• Deep radioactive ores (Uranium · Radium · Plutonium · Polonium · Protactinium) deal Radiation damage when nearby or carried. Armor (except cloth and leather) blocks 20% per piece, and a Gas mask & hazmat suit (made from leather) block 25% per piece — all four pieces block it completely.
• New ores: Copper·Gold (stone pickaxe) · Titanium (iron pickaxe) · Diamond·Red Diamond (crystal pickaxe) · Black Diamond (blazestone pickaxe). Deeper means rarer. Smelt ores in a kiln into ingots and gems, then craft tools and armor, or 9 of them into Copper · Gold · Titanium · Diamond blocks.
• Choose Survival · Creative · Hardcore · Safe · Spectator when creating a world, and change it any time in the pause menu's ⚙ Server Settings.
• Pods of Dolphins leap in the deep sea. Swim next to them for Dolphin's Grace and faster swimming.
• Sea Turtles rest on sandy beaches and swim out to sea. Make a Turtle Shell Helmet from 5 Turtle Scutes to hold your breath 3× longer.
• Squid live in the deep sea and drop Ink Sacs, which the Sage villager buys for coins. Hold a Net (2 Sticks + 4 Sticky Silk) and use it on a squid to catch it alive; use it on water to release it.
• Fish swim in the sea. Catch them or use a Fishing Rod (3 Sticks + 2 Sticky Silk), then cook them in a kiln for Cooked Fish. Cast the bobber and when it dips, right click✋ again! Fish out of water suffocate.
• 🔫 Guns: Pistol (3 Steel + 2 Iron Ingots + 1 Stick) · Assault Rifle (3 Steel Alloy + 2 Steel + 2 Iron Ingots) · Bullets (1 Iron Ingot + 1 Coal → 16). Headshots deal 2×!
• ☢ Nuke (nuclear missile) = 1 Uranium + 1 Plutonium + 1 Steel Superalloy Block (Superalloy Block = Steel + Steel Alloy + Iron Ingot, Steel = Iron Ingot + Stone, Steel Alloy = Steel + Stone). Place it and use it — it rockets into the sky, falls back on the same spot and wipes out a 40-block radius!
• Upgrade crystal gear with Blazestone from deep in the Abyss. Energy Stone is this world's electricity, mined from Energy Stone Ore in deep caves. Very deep down (below height 9) you may find rare, red-glowing Star Power Ore (diamond pickaxe or better).
